'''Dunn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] [[Tyrant (Harrower-class)|''Tyrant'']]. When the [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]] arrived at the ''Tyrant'' to meet with [[Darth Tormen]], Dunn and [[Parson]] attempted to confiscate the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter's]] weapons, but the hunter refused and Dunn was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the conflict.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ensign Dunn appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Bounty Hunter class mission on the ''Tyrant''.
